description: A deterministic, wholly synthetic snapshot designed to demonstrate settlement reconciliation. Each scripted incident is an event with a cause, applied to the merchants it reaches in naturally generated traffic. None of it is a real incident or business claim.

scenarios.name: Normal daily close
scenarios.description: An ordinary EUR day with no incident. Background disputes and data errors can still appear at their usual rate.

scenarios.name: Settlement partner outage / GBP
scenarios.description: A GBP settlement partner stops processing for three days. It carries most travel merchants and a share of every other category, so the late payments follow ordinary traffic: food and drink first, then entertainment, travel and retail.

scenarios.name: Stale fee schedule / EUR
scenarios.description: A repricing campaign cuts fees for many merchants from 1 Oct 2024, but the processor's EUR fee table keeps the old rates until 19 Nov. Every EUR payment those merchants take in between records the old fee.

scenarios.name: Lost settlement file / CAD
scenarios.description: One acquirer's CAD settlement file for 3 Dec 2024 never arrives. That acquirer serves merchants in every category, so the missing payments follow the day's traffic.
